traits.name: Cautious
traits.description: Takes careful steps to avoid risks.

traits.name: Curious
traits.description: Eager to learn and explore new things.

traits.name: Generous
traits.description: Willing to give and share with others.

traits.name: Honest
traits.description: Always tells the truth and is trustworthy.

traits.name: Optimistic
traits.description: Looks on the bright side of situations.

traits.name: Resourceful
traits.description: Able to find quick and clever ways to overcome difficulties.

traits.name: Skeptical
traits.description: Doubts accepted beliefs and questions everything.

traits.name: Compassionate
traits.description: Shows sympathy and concern for others.

traits.name: Leader
traits.description: Naturally takes charge and guides others.

traits.name: Courageous
traits.description: Demonstrates bravery in the face of adversity.

traits.name: Unselfish
traits.description: Puts others' needs before their own.

traits.name: Hard-working
traits.description: Puts in great effort and diligence.

traits.name: Independent
traits.description: Relies on oneself and acts autonomously.

traits.name: Considerate
traits.description: Thinks about the feelings and needs of others.

traits.name: Self-confident
traits.description: Trusts in their own abilities and judgment.

traits.name: Humble
traits.description: Has a modest view of their own importance.

traits.name: Dark
traits.description: Has a somber or mysterious demeanor.

traits.name: Light
traits.description: Has a cheerful or radiant demeanor.

traits.name: Proper
traits.description: Behaves in a socially acceptable way.

traits.name: Fighter
traits.description: Ready to face challenges and conflicts.

traits.name: Expert
traits.description: Highly skilled in a particular area.

traits.name: Imaginative
traits.description: Has a creative and inventive mind.

traits.name: Conceited
traits.description: Has an excessively high opinion of themselves.

traits.name: Happy
traits.description: Feels or shows pleasure and contentment.

traits.name: Studious
traits.description: Spends a lot of time studying or reading.

traits.name: Creative
traits.description: Uses imagination to create new ideas.

traits.name: Intelligent
traits.description: Very smart and quick to understand.

traits.name: Proud
traits.description: Feels deep pleasure or satisfaction in achievements.

traits.name: Humorous
traits.description: Has a good sense of humor.

traits.name: Lazy
traits.description: Unwilling to work or use energy.

traits.name: Adventurous
traits.description: Willing to take risks and try new things.

traits.name: Shy
traits.description: Nervous or timid in the company of others.

traits.name: Ambitious
traits.description: Has a strong desire for success.

traits.name: Reserved
traits.description: Slow to reveal emotions or opinions.

traits.name: Bossy
traits.description: Likes to give orders to others.

traits.name: Witty
traits.description: Shows quick and inventive verbal humor.
